# Tesseract.js

Vendored browser bundle and worker: Tesseract.js 6.0.1, Apache License 2.0.

- Source: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- Distribution: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tesseract.js/v/6.0.1
- Files: `tesseract.min.js`, `worker.min.js`
- License: `LICENSE.md`

The photo checker downloads Tesseract.js-core 6.0.0 from jsDelivr and the standard English and Russian trained language data on first recognition. OCR runs in a browser worker. No photo or recognized text is sent to an inference API.
